candidates.change_summary: Replace the return expression to always return false, bypassing the interface ID check.
Replace the return expression to always return true.
Replace the return expression to return true only if the interfaceId equals the AccessControl specific ID, not IAccessControl.
Replace `return _roles[role].members[account];` with `return false;` so hasRole never returns true.
Replace `return _roles[role].members[account];` with `return true;` so hasRole always returns true for any role/account.
Change getRoleAdmin to always return bytes32(0) instead of the actual admin role.
Change getRoleAdmin to return a constant non-zero value instead of the actual admin role.
Replace the require check with require(false, ...) so renounceRole never succeeds.
Remove the require statement so anyone can renounce any role for any account.
Change require condition to always true, allowing any caller to renounce any role for any account.
Replace account with address(0) in require, allowing renounceRole for any account.
Replace account with _msgSender() in _revokeRole call, so renounceRole always revokes caller's role regardless of account argument.
